airzone_add.zone_title: A thermostat or zone on an existing gateway
airzone_add.zone_help: The Local API does not support physical pairing or unpairing. Moli automatically discovers zones already added to Airzone.
airzone_add.zone_step1: Pair the device using your Airzone system manual or with your installer.
airzone_add.zone_step2: Check that the new zone responds in Airzone, then wait for Moli’s next poll.
airzone_add.zone_step3: Find the zone in Moli, then choose its name and room. A zone on an already configured gateway does not require a restart.
airzone_add.restore_help: Restore its card from the device list. Its readings and history are retained.
airzone_add.gateway_help: A Local API compatible gateway requires a separate driver instance. Moli does not yet install a driver from this page; you can prepare its read-only configuration.
airzone_add.apply_help: This text has not been applied. The administrator must add this block to moli.toml, validate with moli-os check-config and restart Moli. Preserve the vault key and other drivers. HTTPS requires a verified certificate fingerprint; this proposal covers HTTP only.
airzone_add.error.id: Use a 1–32 character ID: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores, starting with a letter. Internal Moli IDs are reserved.
airzone_add.error.duplicate: This instance already exists. Choose another ID to preserve the existing gateway.
airzone_add.error.host: Enter a valid IPv4 address or DNS name, without a protocol or path.
airzone_add.error.port: The port must be an integer between 1 and 65535.
